demo: rs480, x300, x700xt, r9550, x600xt, x550xtx, x850xt, x850xt-agp (legacy CRTC), rs600 and rs690 (AVIVO) 640x480x32 scanout + 2D fill passed

qemu_adapter_note: API usage checked against QEMU master hw/display/ati.c and vga.c (11.1.50); not compiled inside a full QEMU tree and not booted with a guest.

vulkan_backend.build: zig cc 0.16.0 with Khronos Vulkan-Headers (header 1.4.364), -DRLG_HAVE_VULKAN=1; the loader is opened at run time (no link-time dependency); also built and tested without Vulkan headers (stubs)
vulkan_backend.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT, Vulkan 1.4.349, loader 1.4.341 (Windows 11)
vulkan_backend.tests: test-3d vulkan: all 15 groups pass; 29 draws on the GPU, 1 expected software fallback (CBZB clear)
vulkan_backend.mutation_check: removing the end-of-CP flush or target residency makes test_batched fail; CMP operand swap, presub 1-x -> 1+x, BC red/blue swap, stencil op shift and mip level offsets each make 'test-3d vulkan' fail
vulkan_backend.benchmark: tests/bench_3d.c, 640x480 full-screen textured quad: software 101.84 ms/draw (3.0 Mpixel/s), Vulkan phase 1 initially 5.25 ms/draw (58.5 Mpixel/s), 0.33 ms/draw (935 Mpixel/s) after moving the readback staging buffer to HOST_CACHED memory (3.5 ms -> 0.04 ms) and caching images/samplers (0.65 ms -> ~0); with draw batching per CP run, 16 draws per kick: 0.080 ms/draw full screen (3858 Mpixel/s) and 17.5k draws/s for 64x64 quads (4.75k with one draw per kick)
vulkan_backend.spirv_validation: no spirv-val available; modules were accepted and executed correctly by the AMD driver; opcode values checked against SPIRV-Headers
